aliados.meta.title: Our Partners
aliados.meta.desc: Meet the companies and institutions driving UAMOTORS. Discover the benefits of sponsoring our project and accelerating UAM's engineering talent.
aliados.main.title: Our Partners
aliados.intro.text: UAMOTORS is an initiative that seeks to demonstrate the high level of the UAM in global technological scenarios. To materialize our vision and push Mexican engineering to the limit, we look for strategic partners who provide the technical and financial support necessary to turn this development into a competitive reality.
aliados.card1.title: Strategic Alliance
aliados.card1.text: We are not just looking for a sponsor, but a strategic partner that drives the growth of student talent and strengthens technological development in Mexico.
aliados.card2.title: Academia-Industry Link
aliados.card2.text: The project positions companies as promoters of young talent, providing a direct link platform with the university community of the UAM.
aliados.beneficios.title: Key Benefits
aliados.beneficio1.title: Brand Visibility:
aliados.beneficio1.text: Presence of logos on our "OP" race car, uniforms, and promotional material.
aliados.beneficio2.title: Digital Impact:
aliados.beneficio2.text: Constant broadcast on social platforms with a dynamic and continuously growing reach.
aliados.beneficio3.title: Tax Benefit:
aliados.beneficio3.text: Delivery of tax-deductible receipt backed by Fundación UAM.
aliados.beneficio4.title: Presence at Events:
aliados.beneficio4.text: Brand exposure in activities with the university community and team exhibitions.
aliados.cta.title: Accelerate our goal!
aliados.cta.text: Your support is the engine that allows us to take UAM engineering to the next level. To learn about our collaboration schemes and their benefits, contact us and let's work together.
